method: Wash and dry the lettuce and tomato. Shred the lettuce and slice the tomato; put both on a clean plate, separate from the raw filling.
Warm the wholemeal flatbread in a dry frying pan over a medium heat for 30–60 seconds on each side, until flexible. Keep it covered on a clean plate.

Press the 5% beef mince firmly into three short koftas, each no thicker than 1.5cm; no skewers or binder are needed. Coat with all the measured paprika, chilli powder and garlic powder. After handling raw 5% beef mince, wash hands and clean the board, knife and work surface before touching the ready-to-eat ingredients.

Heat the measured olive oil in the non-stick frying pan. Cook the beef koftas over a medium heat for about 10–12 minutes, turning them onto every side. Check the centre with a clean food thermometer: it must stay at 75°C or above for 30 seconds. Without a thermometer, cut the thickest piece open and check that it is steaming inside with no pink meat. Continue cooking until these checks are met; the suggested pan time alone is not a safety check.
Put the lettuce and tomato on the warm flatbread. Add the cooked beef koftas, fold the bread around the filling and serve immediately.
